milestones: As the hopeful singles make their way through the dating pods, instant connections are made, fantasies are crushed, and rivalries quickly emerge.
After getting engaged, two couples finally face each other. Meanwhile, Thiago is determined to win Nanda's heart, and Lissio deals with a dilemma.
Nanda, Lissio and Hudson make their picks and meet their better halves. The lovebirds land in paradise to enjoy a romantic — and eventful — getaway.
Expectations come to a boiling point as the first night approaches. The engaged couples gather at the resort for the first time since the dating pods.
The couples put their relationships to a critical test as they go back to the real world. Rodrigo gets a surprise when he visits Dayanne's apartment.
Back in São Paulo, the twosomes move in together and check up on one another's progress at a barbecue. Tensions arise between Nanda and Thiago.

title_en: Where Do We Go From Here?
milestones: At a party with Hudson’s family, Carol receives a surprise visit. Lissio takes Luana to meet his friends. Dayanne is let down by Rodrigo.
Ana introduces Shayan to her daughter. Klebber and Camila take the gang out to shop for wedding finery. The group throws a birthday party for Nanda.
The men and women celebrate their last moments of singlehood at bachelor and bachelorette parties. Two days later, the first weddings finally unfold.
It's time for the remaining couples to walk down the aisle. Can their whirlwind romances truly lead to happily ever afters?
